title: General Motors, LLC: GM/REAR DRUM BRAKES (18,754 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  PASSENGER VEHICLES EQUIPPED WITH REAR DRUM BRAKES.  THE BOLT HEAD(S) ON THE REAR SPINDLE ROD CAN SEPARATE.

title: General Motors, LLC: GM/FMVSS 201/CONSOLE COVER (487,400 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:    THESE VEHICLES DO NOT COMPLY WITH THE OCCUPANT PROTECTION REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 201, "OCCUPANT PROTECTION IN INTERIOR IMPACT."  THE CONSOLE COVER ON THESE VEHICLES DOES NOT STAY CLOSED WHEN A SPECIFIED VERTICAL LOAD IS APPLIED.

title: BMW of North America, LLC: BMW/REAR BRAKE LEVER (474 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:   MOTORCYCLES.    DUE TO USE OF AN INCORRECT THREAD-LOCKING MATERIAL IN PRODUCTION, IT IS POSSIBLE FOR THE REAR BRAKE LINKAGE BALL END, WHICH IS SCREWED INTO THE REAR BRAKE LEVER, TO LOOSEN AND EVENTUALLY DETACH FROM THE LEVER.

title: Gillig, LLC: GILLIG/FMVSS 108/REFLECTORS (941 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:   LOW FLOOR TRANSIT BUSES.  THESE VEHICLES DO NOT COMPLY WITH THE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 108, "LAMPS, REFLECTIVE DEVICES, AND ASSOCIATED EQUIPMENT."  THE REFLEX REFLECTORS ON THE SIDE, FRONT (AMBER) AND REAR(RED) POSITIONS ARE MISSING.

title: Triumph Motorcycles America, Ltd.: TRIUMPH/SIDE STAND ASSEMBLY (475 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:   MOTORCYCLES.  THE SIDE STAND ASSEMBLY CAN BECOME LOOSE AND DETACH FROM THE MOTORCYCLE.

title: FREIGHTLINER LLC: FREIGHTLINER/FMVSS 121/AIR GAUGE (7 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:    HEAVY TRUCKS BUILT WITH AIR BRAKES THAT DID NOT HAVE AIR GAUGES INSTALLED. THIS DOES NOT COMPLY WITH REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 121, "AIR BRAKE SYSTEMS."

title: FREIGHTLINER LLC: FREIGHTLINER/FMVSS 121/BRAKE APPLICATION TIMING (83 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:    CERTAIN TRACTORS FAIL TO COMPLY WITH FMVSS NO. 121, "AIR BRAKE SYSTEMS."  THE AIR LINES MAY NOT BE ROUTED PROPERLY TO THE DRIVE AXLE SERVICE BRAKE RELAY.

title: INTERNATIONAL TRUCK & ENGINE CORPORATION: INTERNATIONAL/POWER STEERING PUMP (4,534 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  SCHOOL/TRANSIT BUSES AND MEDIUM DUTY TRUCKS.  THE CASTINGS USED ON THE POWER STEERING PUMPS WERE NOT BUILT TO MATCH THE ENGINEERING DRAWINGS, RESULTING IN A THIN WALL IN THE PUMP CASTING OR A COMPLETE CONNECTION OF TWO PASSAGES THAT ARE SUPPOSED TO BE SEPARATED TO CONTROL FLUID FLOW.  THE FLUID FLOW MAY BE REDUCED TO LESS THAN THE MINIMUM REQUIRED FLOW RATE TO PROVIDE FULL POWER ASSIST TO THE BRAKE SYSTEM WITH LOW ENGINE SPEED.

title: INTERNATIONAL TRUCK & ENGINE CORPORATION: INTERNATIONAL/BUNK RESTRAINTS (649 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  HEAVY DUTY TRUCKS BUILT WITH INTERNATIONAL CODE 16SCH (LOWER BUNK WEBBING RESTRAINT).  INCORRECT BOLTS WERE USED TO HOLD THE BUNK WEBBING RESTRAINT LATCH BRACKETS TO THE BUNK BASE.

title: Utility Trailer Manufacturing Company: UTILITY/CONMET PREGREASED HUBS (271 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  VAN-REFRIGERATED/DRY FREIGHT TRAILERS EQUIPPED WITH CONMET PREGREASED TRAILER HUBS AND A TIRE INFLATION SYSTEM.   THE OUTBOARD BEARING ON THE PREGREASED TRAILER AXLE HUBS USED WITH THE TIRE INFLATION SYSTEMS MAY FAIL DUE TO THE INTRUSION OF CONTAMINANTS THROUGH THE TIRE INFLATION SYSTEM.

title: AMERICAN SUSPENSION: AMERICAN SUSPENSION/FORK ASSEMBLY (1,556 affected)
summary: EQUIPMENT DESCRIPTION:  MOTORCYCLE FORK ASSEMBLIES MANUFACTURED FROM MARCH 1, 1999, TO MAY 23, 2000. THE SLIDER TUBE CAN LOOSEN FROM THE AXLE CLAMP OR PISTON WHILE THE MOTORCYCLE IS BEING OPERATED.

title: Volvo Trucks North America: VOLVO TRUCKS/EATON TRANSMISSION (3 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  HEAVY DUTY TRUCKS EQUIPPED WITH EATON AUTOSHIFT GEN II TRANSMISSION ASSEMBLIES.  DUE TO A SOFTWARE PROBLEM IN THE TRANSMISSION ASSEMBLIES, THE TRANSMISSION WILL SELECT THE WRONG GEAR.

title: Saleen, Inc.: SALEEN/ALUMINUM REPLACEMENT WHEEL (472 affected)
summary: EQUIPMENT DESCRIPTION:  ALUMINUM REPLACEMENT WHEELS INSTALLED ON XP8 1999 AND 2000 SALEEN XP* FORD EXPLORER AND MERCURY MOUNTAINEER VEHICLES.  WHEEL SIZE 18" X 8.5", PART NOS. 121-373 PAINTED SILVER, 121-375 CHROMED, AND 121-375 PAINTED WHITE.  THESE WHEELS DEVELOP HAIRLINE CRACKS EMANATING FROM THE REAR SIDE OF THE WHEEL'S SPOKES TOWARDS THE FRONT.

title: FREIGHTLINER LLC: FREIGHTLINER/EATON TRANSMISSION (1,700 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  HEAVY DUTY TRUCKS EQUIPPED WITH EATON AUTOSHIFT GEN II TRANSMISSION ASSEMBLIES.  DUE TO A SOFTWARE PROBLEM IN THE TRANSMISSION ASSEMBLIES, THE TRANSMISSION WILL SELECT THE WRONG GEAR.

title: CPSC, Weed Wizard Acquisition Corp. Announce Recall of Weed Trimmer Heads With Metal Chains
summary: The end link of the trimmer's metal chain can rapidly and unexpectedly detach during use, propelling the link into the air at a high velocity. If the metal link strikes the user or a bystander, it can penetrate skin and bone, causing injury or death. Units: About 2.7 million.

title: CPSC, Firms Announce Recall of Jogging Strollers
summary: Strollers were shipped without straps attached to the frame to secure the seat. Unless the frame straps are attached, a child in the seat of the stroller can lean forward and fall out. Units: About 1,500.

title: CPSC, Firms Announce Recall of Jogging Strollers
summary: The stroller's front wheel connector can crack during use, causing the wheel to separate from the frame. A jogger could lose control of the stroller, or the stroller could suddenly collapse, resulting in injury to a child. Units: About 3,700.

title: CPSC, Discount Stores Announce Recall of Fire Extinguishers
summary: Because of the high-pressure contents of these fire extinguishers, they can explode and expose consumers to flying debris, causing puncture wounds and blast injuries. Units: About 26,000.

title: CPSC, IBM Announce Recall of AC Adapters for Notebook Computers, Mobile Devices
summary: These AC adapters can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 220,000.

title: CPSC, Filter Tech Inc. Announce Recall of Windshield Washer Fluid
summary: The bottles, which contain methyl alcohol, are not sealed with child-resistant closures as required by federal law. Methyl alcohol, also known as methanol, is toxic and can cause blindness or death, if ingested. Units: About 335,000.

title: CPSC, ATICO International Recall Candle Holders
summary: The wooden top of the candle holder can ignite, presenting fire and burn hazards to consumers. Units: About 14,000.

title: CPSC, Hangouts Recall Baby Hammocks
summary: These baby hammocks can suddenly become twisted around children's necks and strangle them. Also, infants sleeping on soft bedding can become wedged in positions in which they cannot breathe. Units: About 350.

title: CPSC, Jack Rabbit Creations Recall Wooden Stacking Toys
summary: The wooden peg in the black and white checked base can come off, presenting a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 9,000.

title: CPSC, Answer Products Inc. Announce Recall of Bicycle Components
summary: The tube that attaches the fork to the bicycle can fail, causing riders to lose control and fall. Units: About 17,500.

title: CPSC, By Us International Co. Ltd. Announce Recall of Bicycle Components
summary: The forks on these bicycles can break apart, causing riders to lose control and fall. Units: About 13,500.

title: CPSC, Kids II Announce Recall of Bouncer Seats
summary: The removable toy bar that attaches to the seat can suddenly release and cause injuries to babies. Units: About 99,000.

title: CPSC, Universal Security Instruments Announce Recall of Smoke Alarms
summary: The smoke alarms can fail to alarm when smoke or fire is present. A capacitor in the alarm can burn out, releasing smoke and melting the cover. Units: About 34,000.

title: CPSC, Warner Bros. Studio Store Announce Recall of Tweety Rattles and Sandals
summary: Both products are being recalled because small parts of each product can detach and pose a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 3,800 Tweety rattles and 1,000 pairs of Tweety sandals.

title: Historical tsunami: waves up to 6 m, Sulawesi, Indonesia (2000-05-04)
summary: A tsunami on 2000-05-04 after an M7.6 earthquake. 54 deaths. From NOAA NCEI's global historical tsunami database.
